net.label: Net build
net.summary: Launch monitor, mat and net. Every number a screen build gives you, without the picture.

components.name: Launch monitor
components.why: The largest line in any build, and the component your room decides for you. Filter by the space its technology needs before you filter by price.

components.name: Hitting mat
components.why: Under every swing you take. A thin mat over a hard base hides fat strikes and sends the shock into your wrists, so this is the last budget to cut.

components.name: Net, side and overhead netting
components.why: Safety equipment before practice equipment. The side and overhead netting catch the shots the main panel was never in front of.

components.name: Software, year one
components.why: Usually a subscription and usually locked to your launch monitor brand. Check both before buying the hardware, and expect it again in year two.

components.name: Room reserve
components.why: Lighting, power to the hitting corner, flooring and a shock layer under the mat. None of this appears in a package price and all of it is cheaper with an empty floor.

screen.label: Screen and enclosure build
screen.summary: The full stack, including the projector and the computer that most package prices leave out.

components.name: Launch monitor
components.why: The largest line in any build, and the component your room decides for you. Filter by the space its technology needs before you filter by price.

components.name: Hitting mat
components.why: Under every swing you take. A thin mat over a hard base hides fat strikes and sends the shock into your wrists, so this is the last budget to cut.

components.name: Enclosure, side and overhead netting
components.why: Holds the screen, controls the light and catches the shots that miss it. Size the protected area for a shank, not for a good drive.

components.name: Impact screen
components.why: Trades image quality against ball-speed tolerance and rebound. This is the first component to cut if the budget will not stretch.

components.name: Projector
components.why: Throw ratio is set by your room, not your preference. A low ceiling or a short room forces a short-throw unit, which costs more for the same brightness.

components.name: Computer
components.why: Simulation is a 3D rendering workload. The machine that handles your email will not necessarily render a course at a frame rate you can putt on.
